action:
After a standard system update you need to restart jabberd2 to make all the
necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that jabberd2 allowed SASL ANONYMOUS authentication even
when it was not enabled in the configuration. A remote attacker could
possibly use this issue to bypass authentication.
isummary: jabberd2 could allow unintended access to network services.
title: jabberd2 vulnerability
